blocks.text: By the end of this chapter, students will be able to:

items: Design interactive GUI-based programs using the Tkinter library.
Connect Python applications to databases and perform CRUD operations.

blocks.text: In this chapter, students will learn to develop user-friendly Graphical User Interfaces (GUIs) using Tkinter, Python's built-in GUI toolkit. They will create windows, frames, labels, buttons, entry fields, and manage layouts using pack(), grid(), and place(). They will practice event handling by linking user actions with functions and developing a simple login form. The chapter also introduces database concepts, SQL, Python database connectivity, and basic CRUD operations using SQLite or MySQL.
